title: Abraham — The Man Who Trusted God
objective: Students will learn about Abraham and how he trusted God's plan.
content: Abraham was a man who loved God very much. God told Abraham to go to a new land. Abraham did not know where he was going, but he trusted God!
God promised Abraham that he would have a big family — as many as the stars in the sky! Abraham and his wife Sarah waited a long time, and then God gave them a baby boy named Isaac.
Abraham trusted God even when it was hard. God wants us to trust Him too! God always keeps His promises, just like He did for Abraham.
activity: Go outside at night and try to count the stars! Draw a picture of Abraham looking at the stars. Color a picture of baby Isaac.
discussion: What did God tell Abraham to do?
How can we trust God like Abraham did?
